profile.headline: Software Engineer at ExtraHop

company.name: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description: Research Engineer on IHME's COVID-19 modeling team

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	Aggregated over 400 unique financial data sources using R to deliver insights on a $417 million portfolio of Global Fund investments. This process included designing a codebase that abstracted away complexity and limited the need for human interaction with raw data, which allowed for greater efficiency and agility when producing results. 
•	Structured financial data for Tableau dashboards to be used by non-technical partners. This included writing a number of validation checks to resolve quality concerns with data before public release, and critically thinking about the format of the database to make it as user-friendly as possible. 
•	Served as the lead analyst for financial data on our research team, which included producing custom analyses for each of our four country partners and our global-level synthesis report. I streamlined this process through designing custom functions, and training other members of our research team to use these functions correctly.
•	Implemented unit-testing and internal verification checks for project databases, and encouraged our team to move towards test-based programming. 
•	Restructured key internal codebases to be more efficient and closer to industry-standard.
•	Implemented a code review process among members of our research team. 
•	Developed a ticket management system for our project.  
•	Under direction from senior researchers, implemented a structural equation model of the health system for tuberculosis in Guatemala, which included modifying the model structure after each iteration.  
•	Designed a machine-learning testing script in Python that uses natural language processing to classify grant activities from Global Fund grantees. 
•	Trained Central American field teams on how to use our survey software, and helped troubleshoot issues with our instruments remotely from Seattle.

positions.title: Data Analyst-Salud Mesoamerica Initiative
positions.description:
Salud Mesoamerica Initiative 
- Led data verification process on primary data from four countries, including designing validation checks in STATA and communicating issues with locally-based field teams daily. 
- Designed surveys to be used by data collectors in low-resource settings, specifically with low access to the internet. Invented ways to shorten the communication lag while survey teams were in the field. 
- Led a training and pilot of data collectors in Chiapas, Mexico and supervised the first few days of field work in remote areas of southern Mexico.

positions.title: Research and Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
- Piloted an internal evaluation of foundation data,  searching for trends and linkages between client’s grants and the wider network of arts education non-profits in Southern California. This project integrated datasets from multiple sources, including state, federal, internal, and competitor data, which included several data types and formats. 
- Analyzed the resulting dataset to provide insights to the foundation director using R and Tableau visualizations. Suggested modifications to foundation strategy based on findings.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant to the McKinnon Center for Global Affairs
positions.description: The McKinnon Center for Global Affairs establishes Occidental College as a top international relations program in the liberal arts. Through coordinating a high-profile speaker series, conferences, and film screenings, The McKinnon Center broadens students' horizons beyond Occidental. My responsibilities at The McKinnon Center included coordinating logistics for speakers, managing creative outreach on social media, acting as an ambassador for the college, and reviewing research grants related to the Global Economy.

positions.title: Intern on the Post-2015 Agenda
positions.description: My work focuses on how the UN will implement the Sustainable Development Goals agreed upon at the Post-2015 summit in September 2015.  Responsibilities include drafting reports, conducting research, managing social media, and handling logistics.

volunteerExperiences.description: At Chrysalis, we believe that a new life starts with a job. We offer job skills training including computer skills, interview and resume workshops, and job retention training for low-income or homeless individuals. My work as a career counselor included working one-on-one with clients on their resumes or cover letters.
